spans.text: CARITIIN TE AlTUCURE LAURILAURICHURU CAJE UNACAURU CURAANAACURU ITA TAOJIAIN

entries.description: Naojoaain te chuisi ne cana rai rauhi
entries.subject: Naojoaain

spans.text: Nii jaun, itolere sacutaain cachaauru relauruhinete, coitucuhin, "Naojoaain te chuisi ne cana rai rauhi," naain coticuuruhine cachaauru laurilaurichuru nenacaauru.

entries.description: saain niichuru te jericha nejeein ne
entries.subject: saain niichuru

spans.text: Nii jaun, nihei chatohaneein, jichojoai, bacauha, ijiaen, jorio, batirichuru, coriqui neba, cailichai cacha, cocoamo, shipibo, acoarona, saain niichuru te jericha nejeein ne, acauru rai rauhi.

entries.task_id: coroatajanemii cocoainanacaihuri|te|aitoha caa rauhi ne rijljleln neine cachaauru rai rauhi
entries.description: coroatajanemii cocoainanacaihuri te aitoha caa rauhi ne riJlJleln neine cachaauru rai rauhi
entries.subject: coroatajanemii cocoainanacaihuri
entries.object: aitoha caa rauhi ne riJlJleln neine cachaauru rai rauhi

spans.text: Joaenreein cacha, niha acaauru rai chatohanai ine, cocoainanacaihuri rai ereeuruhinete, acaauru coroatajanemii cocoainanacaihuri te aitoha caa rauhi ne riJlJleln neine cachaauru rai rauhi.

entries.description: niha cocoainanacai te neruujiha nii ine aonaain
entries.subject: niha cocoainanacai

spans.text: Chaen nii neruujue bana, aonaa ne coina turuha cacha ne, jiaonriha sitaain, naojoaain niha cocoainanacai te neruujiha nii ine aonaain, neeuruhine cachaauru.
Caohachaain coitucuhin, "Esihaen te chuhisi, baaso ichae," naain caohachaain coitucuera lanaala joaenreein cacha casetecaain niha cocoainanacaine caohachaai.

Aca te naojoaain, n e chu aansaaineein ne, "naain joaenreein que ereein ita reroecanaa coacuhin naojoaain neeuruhane, nabana cocoainanacaihuri netonai nii esenetaain, cacha reroecanaa coaucuruha ne coataa.
Chaen te chu ne, acaauru rai rauhi, jeliha natane caunaa jerecuruha ne, caauruha ne coina.
Satiin cacha rai te ne rauhi, nataneu-nenacaauru laurijira niha ne baiha nejelau atane nenacaauru laurijira niha cuha cacha ne.
Satiin cachauru rai te ne rauhi, rai rucuheleeuru, rai atane, naaojoaain erora neein niha ne coina.

entries.description: Cana Coaunera ere esenetaain tonorana jeriha ne
entries.subject: Cana Coaunera

spans.text: Niha satiin cachauru rai rauhi, Cana Coaunera ere esenetaain tonorana jeriha ne, tonoraauruha jianacoo neein cha que tonajelanaala ne coina.

Aca te naojoaain, n e chu aansaaineein ne, "naain joaenreein que ereein ita reroecanaa coacuhin naojoaain neeuruhane, nabana cocoainanacaihuri netonai nii esenetaain, cacha reroecanaa coaucuruha ne coataa.
Satiin cacha rai te ne rauhi, nataneu-nenacaauru laurijira niha ne baiha nejelau atane nenacaauru laurijira niha cuha cacha ne.
Satiin cachauru rai te ne rauhi, rai rucuheleeuru, rai atane, naaojoaain erora neein niha ne coina.
Niha satiin cachauru rai rauhi, Cana Coaunera ere esenetaain tonorana jeriha ne, tonoraauruha jianacoo neein cha que tonajelanaala ne coina.
